summary: Neo regains consciousness in the infirmary to find his body pierced by dozens of acupuncture-like needles wired to a strange device. Dozer, working alongside Morpheus, notes that Neo still needs a lot of work as they operate on him. Neo asks what they are doing; Morpheus explains his muscles have atrophied and they are rebuilding them. Under the unnaturally bright fluorescent light sticks, Neo asks why his eyes hurt, and Morpheus tells him he has never used them before. Morpheus closes Neo's eyes, Neo lays back, and Morpheus tells him to rest because the answers are coming.

what_changes.before: Confused about what is being done to him and why his body feels wrong
what_changes.after: Told his muscles have atrophied and are being rebuilt, and that his eyes hurt because he has never used them before
what_changes.evidence: NEO What are you doing? MORPHEUS Your muscles have atrophied. We're rebuilding them.

what_changes.before: Awake, questioning, and distressed by the needles and pain
what_changes.after: Settled back to rest as Morpheus closes his eyes and promises the answers are coming
what_changes.evidence: Morpheus closes Neo's eyes and Neo lays back. MORPHEUS Rest, Neo. The answers are coming.

event_hint.one_line: Neo is rebuilt and stabilized after being brought aboard the hovercraft.
